exposure: head perineal distance (HPD) at rest and with pressure
cohort: Pregnant women at term gestation who were due for pelvic assessment
finding: The study found that a USG score at term gestation before the onset of labor can predict mode of delivery by cesarean section and spontaneous onset of labor.
mod_finding: A USG score of ≤ 5 had a sensitivity and specificity to predict cesarean section of 84% and 68%, respectively, with a relative risk of 4.9.
